name: Embeddables
long_description: We replace form builders like Typeform and custom code as the way you collect information from users using low code tools. For example you’re a health tech startup and want an onboarding flow but don’t want to use Typeform and don’t have engineering bandwidth. You can use Embeddables to build a totally custom concierge flow and embed it in your app. Then make edits and view analytics, without writing code.
one_liner: The funnel builder built for health & wellness brands.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: co-Founder and CEO of Embeddables. Talk to me about go-to-market, democracy and civic tech.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder of Embeddables (YC S18, embeddables.com, formerly called Savvy). Embeddables is a low-code platform for building and optimizing onboarding funnels, focusing on health and wellness brands. We also have a background in building democracy tools like voter quizzes, having built tools helping millions with their vote. I started my career in journalism, teaching and politics, and am passionate about building tech for a better democracy.
